# @tansy/theme-storefront

A storefront look for the shop plugin: soft rounded product cards, a product stage with a size picker and quantity stepper, and a two-column cart.

```bash
npm install @tansy/theme-storefront
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the storefront theme documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/themes/storefront.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party theme for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
